looks.label: Walking fog
looks.technique: fog texture added over background; sample position = texture coordinate + walk offset + time drift

looks.label: Pulse ripple
looks.technique: radial sine warp of texture coordinates; brightness falls off with 1/length

looks.label: Heat crystal shimmer
looks.technique: five layered cosine steps; used for jelly outfit and heat map preset

looks.label: Ghost outfit
looks.technique: radial blur with colour switched off

looks.label: Fragmented outfit
looks.technique: wired to noise.frag; shader body not read

looks.label: Forge tint flash
looks.technique: flat green (success) or red (failure) silhouette keeping the sprite alpha

looks.label: Gold text outline
looks.technique: eight-sample ring around the glyph for an outline, text shader list

looks.label: Outline pulse
looks.technique: time-driven alpha pulse on the outline

looks.label: Bloom
looks.technique: nine by nine sample grid added to the base colour (81 taps per pixel)

looks.label: Creature burst particle
looks.technique: 0.9 second particle, radius up to 30, velocity band 30 to 55 degrees; emitter burst-rate 25 and burst-count 1
looks.ref: data/particles/creature-particles.otps lines 1 to 27 (colors-stops line 11; particle-type line 27)

looks.label: Group cooldown burst
looks.technique: 50 particles per burst with an attraction affector
looks.ref: data/particles/particles.otps line 30 (burst-count 50) and the affector below it

looks.label: Death window with reconnect
looks.technique: one window with death type and penalty; reconnect scheduled if auto-reconnect is on

looks.label: Monk harmony pips
looks.technique: five pip widgets round the health ring, opacity and fill from harmony value; serene ring opacity from binary state

originals.name: Tier Badge Strip
originals.idea: One strip of ten tier badges indexed by tier, clamped at both ends.
originals.change: each tier adds a glow ramp so top tiers read at 375 wide

originals.name: Mastery Bloom
originals.idea: Visual-only levels beyond the play cap, shown on the weapon sprite and never changing the numbers.
originals.keep: the cap and the visual-only tier
originals.change: a short rim pulse, not a colour overlay

originals.name: Verdict Tint
originals.idea: Green or red silhouette flash on a craft or upgrade result.
originals.change: a 0.4 second hold and a sting

originals.name: Walking Mist
originals.idea: Fog texture that drifts with the walk offset and speed.
originals.change: tint per zone; drift scaled by speed

originals.name: Harmony Pips
originals.idea: Five pips round the health ring as a class resource, plus a binary serene ring.
originals.keep: fixed pip count and a binary state
originals.change: pips fill on hit and drain on a dodge

originals.name: Death Card Without Reconnect
originals.idea: One death window with type and penalty, then a shrine respawn.
originals.change: no reconnect step; respawn at a shrine

originals.name: Ghost Blur
originals.idea: Radial blur with colour removed, for spirit enemies.
originals.change: its own spirit palette and a sound cue

originals.name: Task Ring Trio
originals.idea: Accessory rings in four types, each with one effect (damage, loot, life leech, bestiary chance).
originals.change: our effect names and rarity bands
